about: Unminute's install identity, for tests only (#111 B6a, the owner's decision B6-10). The scripts and the app keep every name as a literal and never read this file; tests/test_consistency.py and tests/powershell keep the copies equal, and pin the names themselves. Changing a name needs the user's say-so (AGENTS.md, K1).
